name: Merrow
traits:
Amphibious. Can breathe air and water.

Optional prologue 'Voyage to Stormwreck Isle' — demands tribute for the Scaled Queen aboard the ship.
actions:
Multiattack: One bite attack and one claw or harpoon attack.

Bite. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage.

Claw. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) slashing damage.

Harpoon. +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10+4) piercing damage.
notes: Optional prologue encounter only — skip if not running the voyage scene.
